name: Ionic (Capacitor)
subtitle: Web-tech mobile apps
creator: Max Lynch, Ben Sperry and Adam Bradley
description: Build mobile apps with HTML, CSS and JavaScript (React, Angular or Vue) and package them for the app stores with Capacitor, which gives web code access to native device features.
useCases: Turning a web app into a store app

languages.youWrite: HTML, CSS and JS with React, Angular or Vue

concepts.explanation: Wraps your web app in a native shell.
Camera, files and notifications from JS.
Your app runs inside an embedded browser.

codeSamples.label: TSX · Ionic React + Capacitor

pros: One codebase for web, iOS and Android
cons: Less native feel than React Native or Flutter

pricing.summary: Free and open source. Store fees: $99/yr (Apple), $25 once (Google Play).
pricing.usageFee: Store fees: Apple $99/yr, Google Play $25 once
